# Then <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
If condition Then statement
```

## Description

Part of the one-line [If](If): the statements after `Then` run when the condition is true. It is left out in the block form of `If`.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
If 2 > 1 Then Print "yes"
If 2 < 1 Then Print "no" Else Print "else part"
```

```text
yes
else part
```
